fact: The article describes an app in which LGA revenue agents register payers, businesses and vehicles and collect and print receipts, on a taxpayers' database, in Oredo and Egor LGAs, Edo State.
The authors say 2 of Edo State's 18 LGAs (Oredo and Egor) use the automated collection system, introduced in March 2017; the text elsewhere says 19 LGAs.
The authors say that before the app, Edo State revenue from drivers, traders and others was collected on manual receipts with no data of collection.
The authors say Edo State previously had no actual data of revenue collection from bus drivers, tricycle operators, traders and shop owners and no comprehensive taxpayer database.
The Edo State government, with the local councils, introduced the system under the Edo Jobs Initiative.
